Security consultant Abass Mustapha Osabutey has declared his candidacy for NDC Deputy National Organiser.

He says his focus is on rebuilding branch structures and using data-driven operations ahead of the 2028 general elections.

Mr Osabutey has served the party for over twenty years in various regional and constituency roles.
